name: 新概念英语 第二册
subtitle: Practice and Progress · 实践与进步
note: 按课次与语法点编排的听力磨耳素材（每课 3 句，英文 + 中文对照）。课名为公开目录信息，练习句为按该课场景与语法点编写，非教材原文；如需替换为教材原文，可在听力详情页用「✏️ 编辑」修改。

s: I met an old friend in the park last Sunday.|上周日我在公园遇到一位老朋友。
We sat on a bench and talked for an hour.|我们坐在长椅上聊了一个小时。
It was a lovely afternoon.|那是个愉快的下午。

lessons.g: 一般现在时与频度副词
s: I usually get up at seven on weekdays.|工作日我通常七点起床。
On Sundays I sometimes stay in bed until nine.|星期天我有时会睡到九点。
He never drinks coffee in the evening.|他晚上从不喝咖啡。
I bought a postcard and wrote a few words on it.|我买了一张明信片，在上面写了几句话。
I sent it to my parents from Rome last month.|上个月我从罗马把它寄给了我父母。
They received it two weeks later.|他们两周后收到了。
I have just finished reading a very long book.|我刚读完一本很长的书。
My brother has lived in Canada for three years.|我弟弟在加拿大住了三年。
He has already visited five different cities there.|他在那里已经去过五座不同的城市。
I have just bought a new bicycle.|我刚买了一辆新自行车。
I bought it two days ago in a small shop.|两天前我在一家小店买的。
I haven't ridden it yet.|我还没骑过。
I moved to a new flat last month.|上个月我搬进了一套新公寓。
There is a park and a supermarket near my building.|我住的那栋楼附近有一个公园和一家超市。
The park is very quiet in the morning.|早上那个公园很安静。
I was waiting for the bus when it started to rain.|我在等公交车时下起了雨。
I had left my umbrella at the office.|我把伞落在办公室了。
By the time I got home, I had been wet through.|等我到家时，我已经全身湿透。
This is the busiest street in our city.|这是我们城市最繁忙的街道。
The new cinema is bigger than the old one.|新电影院比旧的大。
But the tickets there are the most expensive.|但那里的票是最贵的。
We arrived in Shanghai on Friday evening.|我们周五晚上到达上海。
The meeting started at nine o'clock in the morning.|会议在上午九点开始。
In winter, it gets dark before six.|冬天六点前天就黑了。
This table was made in 1950.|这张桌子是1950年做的。
It is made of wood and it is very heavy.|它是木头做的，很重。
It was damaged by my little cousin last year.|去年它被我小表弟弄坏了。
I was reading in the living room when the doorbell rang.|门铃响时我正在客厅看书。
My neighbour had come to borrow some sugar.|我邻居来借糖。
I have lent him things many times.|我借给他东西很多次了。
Our teacher will go to Beijing next Monday.|我们老师下周一去北京。
We shall meet at the school gate at eight.|我们八点在学校门口见。
She will be away for a week.|她将离开一周。
The band is touring the country at present.|这个乐队目前正在全国巡演。
They will be arriving in our city tomorrow.|他们明天将到达我们城市。
They will be staying here for three days.|他们将在这里待三天。
I had a strange experience last month.|上个月我有一次奇怪的经历。
After I had left the office, I walked to the station.|离开办公室后，我步行去车站。
While I was waiting, I met a man who spoke no Chinese.|我在等候时，遇到一个不会说中文的男人。
The manager told me that he would see me at ten.|经理告诉我他十点见我。
I felt nervous when I knocked on his door.|敲他门的时候我很紧张。
He said that the project was going well.|他说项目进展顺利。
If you leave now, you will catch the last train.|如果你现在走，就能赶上末班车。
If it rains later, we will stay at home.|如果稍后下雨，我们就待在家里。
You will feel better if you take a short rest.|如果稍作休息，你会感觉好些。
My aunt is an actress and she loves the stage.|我姑姑是演员，她热爱舞台。
She must be over fifty, but she looks young.|她一定五十多了，但看起来年轻。
She has to keep fit, so she swims every day.|她必须保持身材，所以每天游泳。
I had just sat down when the phone rang.|我刚坐下电话就响了。
I had left my keys on the table, so I had to go back.|我把钥匙落在桌上，只好回去。
I have looked for them everywhere since then.|从那以后我到处找它们。
I have looked for my ticket everywhere.|我到处找我的票。
I have just found it in my coat pocket.|我刚在大衣口袋里找到它。
Someone has already taken my seat.|有人已经坐了我的座位。
Swimming is good exercise for everyone.|游泳对每个人都是好运动。
I enjoy walking by the river after work.|我喜欢下班后在河边散步。
He is interested in learning Chinese.|他对学中文很感兴趣。
The noise from the street keeps me awake every night.|街上的噪音每晚让我睡不着。
The road was built last year, so the traffic has increased.|这条路是去年修的，所以车流增加了。
Something must be done about the problem.|这个问题必须想办法解决。
She dreams of studying abroad one day.|她梦想有一天去国外学习。
He is good at solving difficult problems.|他擅长解决难题。
Thank you for helping me with my homework.|谢谢你帮我做作业。
I got a message from my cousin yesterday.|昨天我收到表姐的一条消息。
She said that she would visit us in October.|她说她十月来看我们。
If she comes, we will take her to the seaside.|如果她来，我们就带她去海边。
I went to the manager's office and sat down.|我去了经理办公室并坐下。
I had just lost my wallet and I felt upset.|我刚丢了钱包，心里很难受。
He said that he would help me look for it.|他说他会帮我找。
I arrived in a new city at last.|我终于到达一座新城市。
The station was big and crowded, and I felt lost.|车站又大又拥挤，我感到迷茫。
I did not know the way, so I asked a policeman.|我不认识路，于是问了一位警察。
I am a student and I paint in my free time.|我是学生，空闲时画画。
Many people say that they love modern art.|很多人说他们热爱现代艺术。
They always tell you what a picture means.|他们总是告诉你一幅画意味着什么。
Late in the afternoon, we put up our tent in a field.|傍晚，我们在田野里搭起了帐篷。
As soon as we had done that, we cooked dinner.|刚搭好帐篷，我们就做了晚饭。
We were all hungry and the food smelt wonderful.|我们都很饿，饭闻起来很香。
He has just bought a small house near the river.|他刚在河边买了一栋小房子。
Ever since he moved in, he has had trouble sleeping.|自从搬进去，他一直睡不好。
He has never lived in a quiet place before.|他以前从未住在安静的地方。
My uncle has bought an unusual old car.|我叔叔买了一辆不寻常的老爷车。
He has driven it to many interesting places.|他开着它去过很多有趣的地方。
He has just taken a group of tourists to the mountains.|他刚带一群游客去了山里。
A small river runs through the park near my home.|一条小河穿过我家附近的公园。
I like sitting by the water on fine afternoons.|我喜欢在晴天的下午坐在水边。
Yesterday some children were playing football there.|昨天一些孩子在那里踢足球。
Yesterday a friend told me about his first job.|昨天一个朋友跟我讲他的第一份工作。
Before he started that job, he had studied for years.|开始那份工作前，他已经学了多年。
He worked very hard and saved a lot of money.|他工作非常努力，攒了很多钱。
Prices are higher now than they were last year.|现在物价高于去年。
Shopping online is easier than going to a shop.|网购比去实体店更容易。
But it is not always the cheapest way.|但这并不总是最便宜的方式。
It was a cold morning when we left the village.|我们离开村子时是个寒冷的早晨。
We walked for hours and finally reached the top.|我们走了几个小时，终于到达山顶。
The view from there was wonderful.|从那里看到的景色美极了。
I have been worried about the exam all week.|我整周都在为考试担心。
Yesterday I finally got the results by email.|昨天我终于通过邮件收到了成绩。
I was told that I had passed.|我被告知我通过了。
He used to work in a bank, but he is a teacher now.|他过去在银行工作，现在是老师。
He has not regretted the change at all.|他完全不后悔这次改变。
Last month he saw an old colleague in the street.|上个月他在街上遇到一位老同事。
She is going to run a marathon next spring.|她打算明年春天跑一场马拉松。
She will start training from next Monday.|她从下周一开始训练。
She hopes to finish the race in four hours.|她希望四小时内跑完。
A big sports event will be held in our city next year.|明年我们城市将举办一场大型体育赛事。
New roads and hotels will be built before it starts.|赛事开始前将修建新的道路和酒店。
Many visitors will be coming from all over the world.|许多游客将从世界各地前来。
They had lived in the south for many years before they moved here.|搬到这里之前，他们在南方住了很多年。
They had often talked about living near the sea.|他们常常谈起住在海边的事。
They had hardly settled in when they decided to move again.|他们刚安顿下来就决定再次搬家。
The doctor asked him whether he felt better.|医生问他是否感觉好些了。
He told the doctor that he still had a headache.|他告诉医生他仍然头痛。
The nurse said that he could go home the next day.|护士说他第二天可以回家。
If you ate more and talked less, you would enjoy your meal.|如果你多吃点少说话，你会更享受这顿饭。
If I were you, I would take a short rest.|如果我是你，我会休息一下。
We would finish earlier if we started now.|如果现在开始，我们会早点完成。

lessons.t: Do you call that a hat?
s: You needn't buy that hat; you already have one.|你不必买那顶帽子，你已经有一顶了。
We mustn't spend money on things we don't need.|我们不应该把钱花在不需要的东西上。
You had better think about it twice.|你最好再考虑一下。
We stopped at a small square to have a rest.|我们在一个小广场停下休息。
After walking all day, we were very tired.|走了一整天，我们非常累。
I am not very good at remembering names.|我不太擅长记名字。
In 1929, an American explorer flew over the South Pole.|1929年，一位美国探险家飞越南极。
At first he was able to take a great many photographs.|起初他能拍很多照片。
Soon, however, he ran into serious trouble.|但很快他就遇到了严重麻烦。
She did not think of the risk when she ran after the man.|她追那个男人时没想过风险。
He had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic.|她野餐时他冲了过来。
She was out of breath when she caught him.|她抓住他时已经上气不接下气。
The whole village learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.|整个村子得知丢失了一大笔钱。
The butcher had lost his wallet on the way to the post office.|屠夫在去邮局的路上丢了钱包。
It was returned later with all the money in it.|后来钱包被还回来，钱一分不少。
When the plane arrived, workers began to unload the boxes.|飞机到达时，工人们开始卸箱子。
No one could explain why one of the boxes was so heavy.|没人能解释为什么其中一只箱子那么重。
It suddenly occurred to a worker to open the box.|一个工人突然想到打开箱子。
A small hotel near my home is up for sale.|我家附近一家小旅馆正在出售。
The owner says that the building is very old.|房主说这栋楼很老了。
He wants to sell it and move to the country.|他想卖掉它搬到乡下去。

lessons.t: Did you want to tell me something?
s: Dentists often ask questions when you cannot answer.|牙医常常在你不能回答的时候提问题。
My dentist had just finished my treatment and told me to rest.|我的牙医刚做完治疗，让我休息。
I tried to say something, but my mouth was full.|我想说话，但嘴里塞满了东西。
Tired of sleeping on the floor, he saved up for a new bed.|厌倦了睡地板，他攒钱买了张新床。
For the first time, he became the proud owner of a bed.|他第一次自豪地拥有了一张床。
A strong wind blew it off the roof that night.|那天晚上一阵大风把床从屋顶吹了下去。
I love travelling in the country, but I don't like losing my way.|我喜欢在乡间旅行，但不喜欢迷路。
My trip took me much longer than I had expected.|我的旅程比我预想的长得多。
The driver told me the bus would take me to the village.|司机告诉我公交车会送我到那个村子。
My friend has always been overweight, so he decided to go on a diet.|我朋友一直超重，所以他决定节食。
He began a week ago and wrote out a long list of foods.|他一周前开始，还写了一份长长的食物清单。
By the end of the week he had forgotten all about it.|到周末时他已经完全忘了这回事。
We have just moved into a new flat.|我们刚搬进一套新公寓。
I have been working hard all morning to get things in order.|我忙了一上午想收拾好。
My sister has been helping me put the books on the shelf.|我妹妹一直在帮我往架子上放书。
At last the firemen put out the big forest fire.|消防员终于扑灭了那场大森林火灾。
Since then, they have been trying to find out how it began.|此后他们一直在查起火原因。
A fireman accidentally discovered the cause later.|一名消防员后来偶然发现了原因。
After breakfast, I sent the children to school.|早饭后我送孩子们去上学。
Then I went to the shops to buy some bread.|然后我去商店买面包。
The children had made a mess while I was out.|我出去的时候孩子们把家里弄乱了。
Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.|最近找到失落宝藏的梦想几乎成真了。
A new machine has been invented to search for metal.|一种寻找金属的新机器被发明出来。
It has been used in many places, but no gold has been found yet.|它已在许多地方使用，但至今没找到黄金。
Once a year, a race is held for old cars.|每年举行一次老爷车比赛。
A lot of cars entered for the race last year.|去年很多车参加了比赛。
One of the most handsome cars was built in 1885.|最漂亮的汽车之一是1885年制造的。
A woman stood at the window of an expensive shop.|一位女士站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。
Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in.|尽管犹豫了一下，她还是走了进去。
The assistant did not like the way she was dressed.|店员不喜欢她的穿着打扮。
A small village is said to have a very old tree.|据说一个小村子里有一棵很老的树。
Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, visitors increased.|因为这棵树被报纸提到，游客增多了。
The villagers now want to protect it.|村民们现在想保护它。
My dog used to sit outside the gate and bark.|我的狗过去常坐在门外吠叫。
Every time he wanted to come in, he would bark until someone opened the gate.|每次它想进来，就会叫到有人开门。
It took me weeks to train him to press the latch.|我花了几周训练它按门闩。
At a fair, I decided to visit a fortune teller.|在集市上，我决定去拜访一位算命师。
She said that I would meet an old friend soon.|她说我很快会遇到一位老朋友。
As I was leaving, I saw a friend walking towards me.|我正要离开时，看到一个朋友朝我走来。
The telescope was launched into space in 1990.|该望远镜于1990年发射升空。
Scientists have been repairing it for several years.|科学家们已经修理它好几年了。
By next year, they will have finished the work.|到明年，他们将完成这项工作。
Firemen had been fighting the fire for weeks before it was controlled.|消防员与大火搏斗了数周才把它控制住。
A short time before, great trees had covered the hills.|不久前，高大的树木还覆盖着山丘。
Now smoke still rose from the warm ground.|现在，温暖的地面仍冒着烟。
He has a large circle of friends and is popular at parties.|他交游广阔，在聚会上很受欢迎。
Everybody admires him for his sense of humour.|大家都钦佩他的幽默感。
Recently a close friend asked him to make a speech at a party.|最近一位挚友请他在聚会上讲话。
In 1858, a French engineer arrived with a plan for a tunnel.|1858年，一位法国工程师带着修建隧道的计划来到这里。
He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the middle.|他说在中间建一个平台是可行的。
If the plan had been accepted then, the tunnel would have opened much earlier.|如果当时这个计划被采纳，隧道会早得多开通。
You must show your ticket before you get on the train.|上车前你必须出示车票。
You should have booked a seat earlier.|你本应该早点订座。
We have to be at the station by eight.|我们必须八点前到车站。
I had my car repaired last week.|上周我把车送去修了。
She had her hair cut before the wedding.|婚礼前她剪了头发。
He had his house painted in the spring.|春天时他请人把房子刷了漆。

lessons.g: can / be able to / manage to
s: He has spent his life studying active volcanoes.|他一生都在研究活火山。
In 1948, he was able to observe a new volcano.|1948年，他得以观察一座新火山。
Although it was dangerous, he managed to take many photographs.|虽然危险，他还是设法拍了很多照片。
I crossed the street to avoid meeting him.|我穿过街道以避开他。
But he saw me and came running towards me.|但他看到了我，朝我跑来。
It was no use pretending that I had not seen him.|假装没看见他是没用的。
I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.|我第三次参加驾照考试。
After having been told to drive out of town, I began to feel confident.|在被要求开出城后，我开始有了信心。
The examiner must have been pleased with my performance.|考官一定对我的表现很满意。
During the match, a man suddenly walked onto the field.|比赛期间，一个男人突然走进场地。
The crowd began to shout, but he was unaware of the danger.|人群开始喊叫，但他没意识到危险。
He was not afraid of anything at all.|他一点也不害怕。
When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is a famous clock.|当你访问伦敦时，最先看到的东西之一是那座著名的大钟。
It is known all over the world because of the radio.|因为广播，它闻名全世界。
If the old building had not been destroyed, the clock would never have been built.|如果那座老建筑没被毁，这座钟就永远不会建成。
He was the first man to drive at over 300 miles an hour.|他是第一个以每小时300英里以上速度驾驶的人。
He set up a new world record in September 1935.|1935年9月他创造了新的世界纪录。
His car was specially built for him.|他的车是为他特制的。
Children who play truant from school are usually not very imaginative.|逃学的孩子通常不怎么有想象力。
A quiet day's fishing is usually as far as they get.|安静地钓一天鱼通常就是他们的极限。
The boy who tried to travel 1,600 miles was caught at last.|那个试图旅行1600英里的男孩最终被抓住了。
An old bus stopped by the river and a group of actors got off.|一辆旧巴士停在河边，一群演员下了车。
Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they hoped nobody would recognize them.|他们戴着墨镜穿着旧衣，希望没人认出他们。
But a policeman recognized them and asked them to move on.|但一名警察认出了他们，让他们继续走。
A light plane flew off course and crashed in the mountains.|一架轻型飞机偏离航线，在山中坠毁。
The pilot was able to send a radio message before the crash.|飞行员在坠毁前用无线电发出了信息。
The wreckage was found two days later.|两天后找到了残骸。
This crop has been grown in the area for over six hundred years.|这个地区种植这种作物已有六百多年。
This is the last year's harvest, and it has just been collected.|这是去年的收成，刚刚收获完毕。
Farmers have already started preparing for next season.|农民们已经开始为下一季做准备。
An ancient painting has just been cleaned by experts.|一幅古画刚由专家清理完毕。
The work lasted three months and it was photographed first.|这项工作持续了三个月，事先拍了照。
The painting is now on show in the city museum.|这幅画现在在市博物馆展出。
After reading an article about health, I decided to change my habits.|读完一篇关于健康的文章后，我决定改变习惯。
I threw away all my cigarettes the next morning.|第二天早上我扔掉了所有的香烟。
A week later, I bought another packet.|一周后，我又买了一包。
I used to travel a lot when I was a student.|我学生时代经常旅行。
My parents used to live in another city.|我父母过去住在另一个城市。
I would take the night train and arrive in the morning.|我常常坐夜车，早上到达。
Perhaps the most extraordinary building of that century was made of iron and glass.|那个世纪最非凡的建筑也许是用钢铁和玻璃造成的。
It was built in a park for a great exhibition.|它是为一场大型博览会而在公园里建造的。
At that time it was the largest building in the world.|当时它是世界上最大的建筑。
Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed his clothes.|他在黑暗中迅速行动，很快换了衣服。
He walked up and down in front of the building for hours.|他在楼前连续来回走了几个小时。
By the morning, he had got away from the area.|到早上，他已经离开了那一带。
Fishermen sometimes claim to have seen strange creatures in the sea.|渔夫有时声称在海上见过奇怪的生物。
People have often laughed at such stories.|人们常常嘲笑这类故事。
A strange fish was caught near the coast last month.|上个月在海岸附近捕到一条奇怪的鱼。
The former chairman was defeated in the recent election.|前董事长在最近的选举中落败。
He is now retiring from public life and has gone abroad.|他现在退出公众生活，已出国。
My friend has always been a strong opponent of his party.|我朋友一直是他所在政党的强烈反对者。
Drivers have decided to go on strike next week.|司机们决定下周罢工。
The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.|罢工定于周二开始。
Many car owners are going to offer free rides to people going to work.|许多车主打算为上班的人提供免费搭载。
I have just received a letter from my old school.|我刚收到母校的一封信。
It tells me that my former teacher will be retiring next week.|信中说我的前任老师下周退休。
The students will be sending him a present.|学生们将送他一件礼物。
As he tried to turn the boat, the wheel came away in his hands.|他试图让船转向时，方向盘在他手中脱落了。
He waved desperately to his friend.|他拼命向朋友挥手。
Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening.|两人几乎来不及意识到发生了什么。

lessons.g: 一般过去时与间接引语
s: At the time of the accident, I was travelling on the eight o'clock train.|事故发生时，我正乘坐八点的火车。
The inspector asked whether I always caught such an early train.|探长问我是否总赶这么早的火车。
I said that I always caught an early train because I had to be at work by nine.|我说我总是赶早班车，因为我九点必须上班。
Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.|六个人被困在矿井里十七个小时了。
If they are not brought up soon, they may lose their lives.|如果不尽快把他们救上来，他们可能丧命。
Two men were able to drill a hole and brought them food and water.|两个人钻了一个孔，给他们送去了食物和水。
People will do anything to see a free show.|人们为了看免费演出什么都会做。
When the news got round, we all rushed to the cinema.|消息传开后，我们都赶去了电影院。
The speaker made a slip of the tongue and everyone laughed.|演讲者口误，大家都笑了。

lessons.g: 现在完成与现在完成进行
s: For some time now, I have been trying to get a good job.|一段时间以来，我一直在努力找份好工作。
I have been to several interviews, but nothing has come of them yet.|我参加了几次面试，但都还没有结果。
What is for supper? I have been working all day.|晚饭吃什么？我干了一整天活。
A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be flying towards the airport.|一名飞行员注意到一个气球似乎正飞向机场。
He informed the control tower at once, but nobody could explain the mystery.|他立即通知了控制塔，但没人能解释这个谜。
Three men were standing in the basket of the balloon.|三个人站在气球的吊篮里。
It must have been about two in the morning when I got home.|我回到家时大概已是凌晨两点。
I tried to wake my wife by ringing the doorbell, but she was asleep.|我按门铃想叫醒妻子，但她睡着了。
I had to climb up to the bedroom window.|我不得不爬到卧室窗户那儿。
One of the most famous monuments in the world was presented to the United States by the people of France.|世界上最著名的纪念碑之一是法国人民赠送给美国的。
The great statue took ten years to complete.|这座巨大的雕像花了十年完成。
It was transported across the sea in a ship and put together there.|它用船运过海，在那里组装起来。
Experiments have proved that children can be taught to swim at a very early age.|实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就能被教会游泳。
In a special pool, children become expert at holding their breath under water.|在一个特别的泳池里，孩子们成了在水下屏息的专家。
Most of them are so used to swimming that they can pick up weights from the bottom.|他们大多如此习惯游泳，以至于能从池底捡起重物。
When the ambassador returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.|大使回家吃午饭时，他妻子吓了一跳。
He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.|他脸色苍白，衣服一团糟。
If you had told me you were coming, I would have prepared a meal.|如果你早告诉我你要来，我会准备一顿饭。
A festival for the dead is held once a year in some countries.|在一些国家，每年举行一次亡灵节。
It is a cheerful occasion, for on this day the dead are said to return home.|这是个欢乐的场合，因为据说这一天死者会回家。
Food is laid out for the dead, and the living eat it afterwards.|食物为死者摆好，之后生者把它吃掉。
